name: Spellbound Cinema
summary:
Turn your Quest into a private cinema in a world of magic.

Spellbound Cinema plays the videos you already own on a giant screen inside hand-crafted, movie-quality environments with real stereo depth:

- Lakeside Castle: a castle on a cliff above a moonlit lake, lanterns glowing on the pier.
- Sunset Fortress: sit on an old stone bridge above a sea of forest, a castle glowing in the sunset.
- Enchanted Library: a moonlit reading hall of endless books, a fire crackling behind you.
- Midnight Void: pure darkn
